project_type: React + Vite + TypeScript video conferencing app using Amazon Chime SDK and AWS Amplify
build_system: Vite with npm scripts. Build command: 'tsc -b && vite build'. Note: requires amplify_outputs.json (gitignored) for import in App.tsx - a stub file is needed for build to pass.
test_framework: No test files exist in this project. Lint via eslint.
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to verify TypeScript compilation and Vite build. 2. Run npm run lint to ensure no lint errors.
setup_instructions: npm install, then create amplify_outputs.json stub for build
environment_constraints: amplify_outputs.json is gitignored and not available - must create a minimal stub for TypeScript compilation. No tests exist to run. The project uses styled-components (via Chime SDK) and @aws-amplify/ui-react for styling.
contribution_requirements: Uses prettier and eslint via husky pre-commit hook. lint-staged configured for .ts files.
key_patterns: Components use @aws-amplify/ui-react components (Card, View, Heading, Text, Button, Flex, Grid, Image, useTheme) and amazon-chime-sdk-component-library-react for meeting functionality. Styling is done via Amplify UI tokens (useTheme -> tokens.space, tokens.radii etc.) and inline styles. No custom CSS files exist. The app uses styled-components ThemeProvider with lightTheme from Chime SDK.
directory_structure: src/ contains App.tsx (main component), main.tsx (entry point), components/ (Header, MeetingControlBar, VideoMeeting, CopyLink, AttendeeList). public/ has icons. amplify/ has backend resources.
